# Card 371: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1690) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5130/pc_hcp_371_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5131/pc_hcp_371_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](371.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

One struck-through cluster at start of main-2 is a single unknown-length mask. Main and margin order unresolved. Small cap above r represented provisionally by ř, alternative r + detached mark. Ordinary date excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `6d6564ed60e05475d31065458ea329894aab2ea18c01dbe9f51c50725e75a432`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics are editorial.

proposed_czech:
Upřímný dík, zlato moje, za [?] drahý lístek. Byl jsem žárliv na Tvého pana bratrance. Nechtěl bych ztratiti srdéčko Tvé, které je mi tak drahé. Byla mi divná návštěva pana před [?] u Tebe v Žirovnici. V neděli a včera jsem opět hlídal svoji postýlku, poněvadž mne mocí bolela hlava. Dnes je zase již dobře. Dnešní dopoledne ztrávil jsem v císařské knihovně a nyní chystám se do úřadu. Vzpomínal jsem včera i v neděli mnoho, co dělá asi moje jediné srdéčko. Pac a tisíc vášnivých, dlouhých pus posílá ti věčně Tvůj Pepouš, který prosí opět o brzký lístek.

Stýská se mi po Tobě moc!
proposed_english:
Heartfelt thanks, my darling, for [unread struck-through cluster] your dear letter. I was jealous of your gentleman cousin. I would not wish to lose your little heart, which is so dear to me. The visit of Mr [unclear designation after source PRED] to you in Žirovnice seemed strange to me. On Sunday and yesterday I again stayed in bed, since my head hurt badly. Today it is well again. I spent this morning in the imperial library, and now I am getting ready to go to the office. Yesterday and on Sunday I thought a great deal about what my one and only sweetheart might be doing. Pac [an affectionate gesture, meaning uncertain], and a thousand passionate, long kisses to you from your forever Pepouš, who again asks for a letter soon.

I miss you very much!
